dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です。本日はご相談ありがとうございます。年齢、性別、ご相談内容を教えて下さい。
dialogue.English: Good evening, this is the counselor. Thank you for consulting with us today. Could you please tell me your age, gender, and the nature of your concern?

dialogue.content: こんばんは。よろしくお願いします。50歳男です。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for speaking with me. I'm a 50-year-old man.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。なんでもお話し下さいね。
dialogue.English: It's a pleasure to speak with you. Please feel free to talk about anything that's on your mind.

dialogue.content: 職場内の異動に関することでストレスが溜まって、体にも変調をきたしています。
dialogue.English: I'm under a lot of stress because of a transfer at work, and it's starting to affect my physical health.

dialogue.content: それで、どうしたらよいかと思いご相談した次第です。
dialogue.English: That's why I decided to consult with you; I'm not sure what to do.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。お話し下さり、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 現在のご体調はいかがですか？調子が悪くなられたら、いつでもおっしゃって下さいね。
dialogue.English: How are you feeling physically at the moment? If you start to feel unwell, please don't hesitate to tell me.

dialogue.content: 今は落ち着いています。今日仕事や済んだので。
dialogue.English: I'm feeling calm now, since I finished work today.

dialogue.content: 休んだので、でした。
dialogue.English: I meant, because I took the day off.

dialogue.content: 落ち着かれていて良かったです。今日はお休みされたのですね。ご体調が優れなかったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm glad you're feeling calm. So you took the day off today. Was it because you weren't feeling well?

dialogue.content: 昨夜から片方の耳があまりよく聞こえなくなったというか、
dialogue.English: Since last night, I haven't been able to hear very well out of one of my ears, or rather...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 耳の中にもう一つスピーカーがあるような感じで、おかしくなったのです。
dialogue.English: It felt strange, as if there was another speaker inside my ear.

dialogue.content: それで、こういうのは早く医者に行って診てもらった方がいいと思ったので、休んで耳鼻科に行きました。
dialogue.English: So I thought it would be best to see a doctor about this promptly, so I took the day off and went to an ENT specialist.

dialogue.content: 鼓膜を見たり、検査とかは異常なかったんですけど、神経的なものかもねーと言われ、疲れとかよく眠れてないとかストレスとか、少し話をして、薬をもらってきて終わりでした。
dialogue.English: They checked my eardrum and ran some tests, but there were no abnormalities. The doctor said it might be nerve-related—due to things like fatigue, lack of sleep, or stress. We talked a little, they gave me some medication, and that was it.

dialogue.content: それは驚かれたのではないでしょうか。耳鼻科を受診されるのが安心ですよね。受診結果も教えていただき、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: That must have been alarming. It's reassuring that you went to see an ENT specialist. Thank you for sharing the results of the consultation with me.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お薬で落ち着かれたような感覚はありますか？神経的なものと言われたとのお話ですが、どのように感じられましたか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel any sense of relief from the medication? You mentioned they said it might be neurological—how did that make you feel?

dialogue.content: まだ薬は飲み始めたばかりなので、効果とかはよくわからないですけど、
dialogue.English: I've only just started taking the medication, so I can't really tell if it's effective yet, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 診断結果は、まあそんな感じだろうなというか、想定内でした。
dialogue.English: As for the diagnosis, well, I figured it would be something like that. It was what I expected.

dialogue.content: 目に見えてわかるような症状ではないんだろうなとは思ってたので。
dialogue.English: I had a feeling it wasn't the kind of symptom that would be visibly obvious.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。やはり、神経的なものやストレスの可能性があると思われていたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you already suspected that it might be related to your nerves or stress.

dialogue.content: 心のことは、外には見えにくいものですものね。
dialogue.English: Matters of the mind are hard to see from the outside, aren't they?

dialogue.content: 妻が依然職場のストレスで突発性難聴になったので、そんな感じなのかなと思っていました。
dialogue.English: My wife previously developed sudden hearing loss due to workplace stress, so I thought it might be something like that.

dialogue.content: なかなか、どの科に行けばいいかとか、悩むところでしたがとりあえず耳鼻科かなと。
dialogue.English: I wasn't sure which specialist to see, but I thought the ENT clinic was a good place to start.

dialogue.content: なるほど、奥様もストレスの影響で耳に症状が出られたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so your wife also experienced ear-related symptoms due to stress.

dialogue.content: そうですね、まずはどこかにかかってみようと考えますよね。しっかり行動に移されていますね。
dialogue.English: Yes, it makes sense to think about seeing a doctor somewhere first. It's great that you took action.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。だからそれと似たようなものかなって。医師は病名を断定はしなかったですけどね。
dialogue.English: Exactly. That's why I thought it might be something similar. The doctor didn't definitively name the condition, though.

dialogue.content: そうですか。病名をおっしゃられないときは、「じゃあ、なんだろう？」というお気持ちになられますよね。ご職場の異動でストレスが溜まられているとのことですが、人間関係の変化やお仕事内容の変化など、色々おありだと思いますが、お話をお伺いさせていただいてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: I see. When a doctor doesn't give a specific diagnosis, it can make you wonder, 'Then what could it be?' You mentioned that you're stressed about a transfer at your workplace. I imagine there are many aspects to that, such as changes in work relationships or job responsibilities. Would you be comfortable talking more about that?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。相談者様は、どのようなことがストレスになっていると感じられていますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What aspects of this situation do you feel are causing you the most stress?

dialogue.content: 自分は今、実際に所属している会社から、仕事をもらっていた会社に出向いて仕事をしているんですけど、
dialogue.English: I'm currently seconded from my own company to work at another company that gives us projects.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 先月で丸2年になって、ここ半年くらいは、ずっと同じ仕事をすることが出来て、上司が変わったりいろいろあったんですけど、比較的落ち着いて仕事が出来てたんです。
dialogue.English: Last month marked a full two years. For the past six months, I've been able to work on the same thing consistently. And although there were some changes, like a new boss, things were relatively calm and I could focus on my work.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それが、本当のところはよくわからないんですけど、今の部署に他から自分と同じ立場の人が複数人入ってきて一緒に仕事してるんですけど、
dialogue.English: However, and I'm not entirely sure what the real situation is, several other people in the same position as me have recently joined the department, and we're all working together now.

dialogue.content: 近々その人たちに仕事を任せて、僕が他部署に行くという話がここ1，2か月ずっと出ていて、
dialogue.English: For the last month or two, there has been talk that my work will soon be handed over to them, and I will be transferred to a different department.

dialogue.content: ええ（聞いていますので、どうぞ続けて下さいね。）
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm listening. Please continue.

dialogue.content: でもそれは然るべき人、例えば上司とかからははっきりしたことを一切言われてなくて、あくまでも予定というか噂というか憶測というか、そういう段階でずっと来てるんです。
dialogue.English: But I haven't been told anything definite from anyone in charge, like my boss. It's all remained at the level of a possibility, a rumor, or just speculation this whole time.

dialogue.content: なるほど。どのような背景か、はっきりわからない状態なのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So it's a situation where the reasons behind it aren't clear at all.

dialogue.content: それで月が替わって、3月で今の上司が退職することになって、いろいろ配置換えとか人数調整とかの話が一気に出てきて、一気に現実味を帯びてきたんですね。
dialogue.English: Then the new month started, and my current boss is retiring in March. All at once, there was talk of reassignments and staffing adjustments, and suddenly it all felt much more real.

dialogue.content: でも相変わらず会社自体からは何も、今度はどこに行くとか言われてなくて、それがいつまでたっても出てこないのが腹立たしいやら不安やら情けないやらで、一気にストレスが溜まってしまったんです。
dialogue.English: But still, the company itself hasn't told me anything about where I'll be going next. The fact that I'm still not being told, no matter how much time passes, makes me angry, anxious, and feel pathetic, and all the stress has piled up at once.

dialogue.content: なるほど、先行きがわからない状態が長く続かれているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so this state of uncertainty about your future has been continuing for a long time.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 非正規なのでなかなか強いことも言えなくて。
dialogue.English: And since I'm not a permanent employee, it's difficult for me to be assertive about it.

dialogue.content: 噂や憶測だけでは、色々な想像はできても、実際の状況がわからないですものね。
dialogue.English: With only rumors and speculation, you can imagine many possibilities, but you can't know what's really happening, can you?

dialogue.content: 事情を伺うにも、お気を使われる状態なのですね。
dialogue.English: So you feel you have to be careful even just asking about the circumstances.

dialogue.content: 一番の問題はそこなんです。調整中なのかもしれないけど、急に言われるのも嫌だし。
dialogue.English: That's the main problem. They might still be figuring things out, but I also hate the idea of being told suddenly.

dialogue.content: なるほど。急だと心の準備ができませんよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It's hard to prepare yourself mentally if it's sudden.

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 長い期間、どうなっているのだろうと気にし続けられるのは、大変でしたね。
dialogue.English: It must have been so difficult to keep worrying about what's going on for such a long period.

dialogue.content: そうですね。本人が蚊帳の外にいる感じが最近は特にしてて、とてもつらいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, it is. Lately, I especially feel like I'm being kept out of the loop, and it's very painful.

dialogue.content: それはお辛いですね。ご自身のことだからこそ、調整中であればそのように言ってもらえれば、少しでも違うと感じたのですが、どう思われますか？
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult. Since this is about you, I imagine that even if they just told you that things were 'still being arranged,' it might feel a little different. How do you feel about that?

dialogue.content: だからそういうことを全然こちらに言ってくれないので、まあ異動自体したくないんですけど、早く言ってもらえるだけでも違ったとは思います。
dialogue.English: Exactly, they don't tell me anything like that. I mean, I don't want to be transferred at all, but I do think it would have been different if they had just told me sooner.

dialogue.content: そうですね。早く言って欲しいですよね。ご相談者様ご自身でも、きっとお考えになられたことかもしれないのですが、ご職場のどなたかで、そのようなお話ができそうな方はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Yes, you just want them to tell you sooner, don't you? You may have already considered this, but is there anyone at your workplace with whom you might be able to discuss this?

dialogue.content: まあいろいろ、同僚同士で愚痴ってはいますが、その域を脱することがないので、それ以上のことはいくらこちらで憤っててもわからないことなので、その繰り返しですかね。
dialogue.English: Well, we do vent about it among colleagues, but it never goes beyond that. No matter how much I fume about it on my own, there are things I'll never find out, so it's just the same cycle repeating.

dialogue.content: 同僚の方で、同じように感じられている方がいらっしゃるのですね。お気持ちをわかって下さる方がいるのは、安心できますね。上司の方や、人事に関係されている方には、非正規ということからお聞きになりにくい状況でしょうか？
dialogue.English: So you have colleagues who feel the same way. It's reassuring to have people who understand, isn't it? When it comes to your superiors or someone in HR, is it difficult to ask because of your status as a non-permanent employee?

dialogue.content: まあそうですね、、聞こうと思えば聞けるとは思うんですけど、それで話が一気に決まっちゃうのも、やぶへびな
dialogue.English: Well, yes... I suppose I could ask if I tried, but I'm afraid that might force their hand and things would get decided on the spot, which could backfire.

dialogue.content: 感じがして、なかなか聞けずにいます。
dialogue.English: I have a feeling it might, so I haven't been able to bring myself to ask.

dialogue.content: あくまでもはっきり決まっていない前提のことを、こちらから聞くのも不自然ですし。
dialogue.English: Besides, it would feel strange for me to be the one asking about something that hasn't been officially decided yet.

dialogue.content: なるほど、何か影響があるかもしれないのが、少し怖い気もしますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. The thought that asking could have some kind of negative impact is a bit frightening, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうなんです。
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: 怖いのが結構あるかもしれない。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think there's quite a bit of fear involved.

dialogue.content: そうですね。聞きづらいことだと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I can imagine it's a very difficult thing to ask about.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご相談者様が、今、一番大きな問題と感じられていることは、やはりそのストレスがご体調に出てきてしまっていることかと思うのですが、このストレスを緩和するために、何ができることやしたいと思われていることはありますか？
dialogue.English: It seems the biggest problem for you right now is that this stress is starting to manifest physically. To help alleviate this stress, is there anything you think you could do, or that you would like to do?

dialogue.content: よく休むことが一番いいと思うんですけど、何日も休むわけにもいきませんし、それ以外には考えられることは今はないかな、という感じです。
dialogue.English: I think the best thing would be to get a lot of rest, but I can't take too many days off from work. Other than that, I can't really think of anything at the moment.

dialogue.content: なるほど、身体を休めることは大切ですね。とても良い方法だと思います。何日も休めない、というお気持ちもわかります。移動などの件は、何月までに決まる、というような予測などはできますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Resting your body is very important, and I think that's an excellent idea. I also understand why you feel you can't take many days off. Regarding the transfer, do you have any prediction as to when it might be decided—for example, by which month?

dialogue.content: おそらく今月中には何か動きがあるんじゃないかと思いますが、それこそ憶測の域を出ないので、よくわからないです。
dialogue.English: I suspect there might be some development by the end of this month, but again, that's just speculation, so I really don't know for sure.

dialogue.content: そうですか。今月中、と決まっていれば、「そこまでの我慢」と思えることもあるけれど、はっきりしていないのが辛いですね。もうすぐお時間になってしまうので、ここまでご相談をお伺いして、私が感じたことをお伝えさせて頂ければと思うのですが、よろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. If you knew for sure it would be this month, you could tell yourself you just have to endure until then, but the uncertainty is what makes it so difficult. Our time is almost up, so if it's alright with you, I would like to share some of my impressions from our conversation.

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please do.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。まず、ご相談者様が異動に関して長い期間はっきりわからない状況や、蚊帳の外のように感じられるのは、当然のことだと思います。
dialogue.English: Thank you. First, I want to say that it's completely understandable for you to feel the way you do about this prolonged, uncertain situation regarding the transfer, and to feel as though you've been left out of the loop.

dialogue.content: お身体にも影響が出ているので、決して無理なさらないで下さいね。
dialogue.English: Since it's affecting your physical health, please don't push yourself too hard.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 無理はしないようにします。
dialogue.English: I'll try not to overdo it.

dialogue.content: また、先行きがご自身で決められないことなので、それまで、お気持ちのゆるむ何かを探してみて下さい。
dialogue.English: Also, since this is something you can't control, I encourage you to try to find something that helps you relax in the meantime.

dialogue.content: 決まるまでのお時間の過ごされ方を、お仕事から離れたところで探してみて下さい。
dialogue.English: Try to find ways to spend your time, away from work, until things are decided.

dialogue.content: そうですね。考えすぎない程度に考えてみます。
dialogue.English: You're right. I'll think about it, without overthinking it.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ご相談者様は、一生懸命お仕事に向かわれている方だと感じましたので、あまりご心配なさらずに、今のままでお仕事を無理のないペースで続けられ、これまでの頑張りに自信を持って、お仕事以外で楽しみながら、少しその問題から離れてみられるのもいいかもしれません。
dialogue.English: I get the impression that you are a very dedicated worker. Please try not to worry too much. Perhaps you could continue your work at a manageable pace, have confidence in all your efforts up to now, and try to distance yourself from the issue a little by finding enjoyment in things outside of work.

dialogue.content: そうですね、あまりそう言ってくれる人がいないので、その辺はありがたかったです。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: You're right. Not many people say things like that to me, so I really appreciate it. Thank you.

dialogue.content: すぐに解決につながらない内容になってしまったかもしれませんが、それでもお辛い時は、いつでもご相談お待ちしています。同じお話になっても構いませんので、話すことで楽になれるようでしたら、どのようなことでもお聴かせ下さいね。
dialogue.English: I know this may not lead to an immediate solution, but please remember that you can always contact us whenever you're feeling distressed. It's perfectly fine to talk about the same things again. If talking helps you feel any lighter, please feel free to share anything at all.

dialogue.content: はい、わかりました。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Okay, I understand. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、ありがとうございます。今日はいかがでしたか？何かまだお話しされたいことなどはありますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. How are you feeling after our talk today? Is there anything else you would like to discuss?

dialogue.content: まあ、ないと言えばうそになりますけど、まだ確定していないことばかりなので、今日はこの辺にしたいと思います。
dialogue.English: Well, it would be a lie to say there isn't more, but since it's all about things that are still uncertain, I think I'd like to stop here for today.

dialogue.content: そうですね、色々なお気持ちを抱えられて来て頂いたと思いますので、今日はその一部だったと思いますが、お話しして下さって、ありがとうございました。また、いつでもお待ちしております。しらたまさんのご心配が早くなくなることを心よりお祈りしております。
dialogue.English: I understand. I imagine you came here today with many complicated feelings, and this was just a part of that, but thank you for sharing with me. Please know we're always here for you. I sincerely hope your worries will ease soon, Mr. Shiratama.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。では失礼します。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'll be going now.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。それでは、これで相談を終了させて頂きます。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. We will now conclude this counseling session.
